summary.en: Colombian automaker Auteco built a Gemini-powered conversational agent that slashed task times from days to seconds.

overview.en: Auteco is a leading Colombian vehicle manufacturer that distributes motorcycles and vehicles across Latin America. The company leveraged Google Cloud's Gemini models to build a conversational AI agent that assists thousands of customers and internal users. The deployment delivered notable operational efficiency gains — reducing previously multi-day tasks to near-instant results — and also optimized Auteco's marketing campaigns.
overview.zh: Auteco 是哥倫比亞領先的車輛製造商，在拉丁美洲各地銷售摩托車與汽車。該公司利用 Google Cloud 的 Gemini 模型建構了一個對話式 AI 代理，服務數千名客戶與內部使用者。此次部署帶來了顯著的運營效率提升，將原本需要數天才能完成的工作壓縮至幾乎即時完成，同時也優化了行銷活動的成效。

en: Built a conversational AI agent using Gemini models on Google Cloud
Reduced key operational tasks from multiple days down to seconds
Serves thousands of users across customer-facing and internal workflows
Optimized marketing campaign management through AI capabilities

overview.en: Continental, a global automotive technology supplier, partnered with Google Cloud at IAA Mobility 2023 to bring generative AI into vehicles. The company integrated Google Cloud's conversational AI into its Smart Cockpit High-Performance Computer (HPC) — an in-vehicle speech-command platform — enabling drivers to ask natural-language questions about points of interest, navigation, and more during their trips. By end of 2024, 30 vehicle models from different manufacturers were rolling off assembly lines with Continental's HPC.

Drivers can ask natural-language questions about hotels, tourist attractions, and navigation in real time
30 vehicle models from multiple manufacturers equipped with Continental HPC by end of 2024
Brought to market in 18 months from order to production

The system uses Datastream pipelines to keep a real-time BigQuery data lake synchronized, while Gemini processes large volumes of AI requests securely and at speed, ultimately expanding Mobiauto's revenue and customer portfolio.
overview.zh: Mobiauto 是巴西的汽車買賣平台。該公司採用 Gemini 與 BigQuery 打造「購車顧問」AI 工具，能向每位買家推薦最合適的車型、自動生成車輛廣告文案，並為經銷商整理潛在客戶摘要。系統透過 Datastream 管線維持即時的 BigQuery 資料湖同步，Gemini 則安全、快速地處理大量 AI 請求，最終擴大了 Mobiauto 的營收與客戶規模。

summary.zh: PODS 與廣告公司 Tombras 運用 Gemini，在 29 小時內為紐約市全部 299 個社區生成逾 6,000 則超本地化廣告標題。

overview.en: PODS, a portable storage and moving company, partnered with advertising agency Tombras and Google to create the 'World's Smartest Billboard' campaign. A PODS truck drove across New York City, and Tombras used Google Cloud Vertex AI with Gemini 1.5 Pro to generate hyper-local, real-time ad headlines based on GPS location, traffic, weather, and neighborhood context. The campaign covered all 299 NYC neighborhoods in 29 hours, generating over 6,000 unique headlines. It debuted at Cannes Lions 2024 and drove a 60% increase in NYC website sessions and a 33% rise in quote requests.
overview.zh: PODS 是一家可攜式儲存與搬運公司，與廣告公司 Tombras 及 Google 合作推出「全球最聰明廣告看板」活動。PODS 貨車行駛於紐約市，Tombras 使用 Google Cloud Vertex AI 搭配 Gemini 1.5 Pro，根據 GPS 定位、交通狀況、天氣及社區情境即時生成超本地化廣告標題。活動在 29 小時內覆蓋紐約市全部 299 個社區，生成逾 6,000 則獨特標題。活動於 2024 年坎城創意節首亮相，帶動紐約市網站瀏覽量增加 60%，報價請求提升 33%。

en: Gemini 1.5 Pro on Vertex AI generated real-time hyper-local ad headlines based on GPS, weather, and traffic
Covered all 299 NYC neighborhoods in just 29 hours
Created over 6,000 unique headlines — a first for out-of-home advertising
60% increase in NYC website sessions and 33% rise in quote requests
Campaign debuted at Cannes Lions 2024 as part of Google's 'Impossible Ads' program

summary.en: UPS Capital's DeliveryDefense uses ML on Google Cloud to score address delivery confidence and cut post-delivery losses by up to 30%.
summary.zh: UPS Capital 的 DeliveryDefense 在 Google Cloud 上以機器學習對地址投遞信心評分，可將投遞後損失降低最多 30%。

overview.en: UPS Capital launched DeliveryDefense Address Confidence, an AI and machine learning product that analyzes 11 billion UPS deliveries across 130 million addresses to assign a confidence score from 100 (high risk) to 1,000 (safe). The system uses BigQuery as the data repository and Vertex AI to run fraud detection and route anomaly models on real-time and historical data. Shippers can use these scores to proactively reroute or hold at-risk packages before theft or loss occurs.
overview.zh: UPS Capital 推出 DeliveryDefense Address Confidence，這是一款 AI 與機器學習產品，透過分析 130 億筆 UPS 投遞記錄（涵蓋 1.3 億個地址），為每個地址給出 100（高風險）至 1,000（安全）的信心評分。系統以 BigQuery 作為資料儲存庫，並透過 Vertex AI 對即時與歷史資料執行詐欺偵測與路線異常模型。託運商可利用這些評分，在包裹遭竊或遺失前主動重新安排路線或暫扣高風險包裹。

en: Analyzes 11 billion UPS deliveries across 130 million addresses to generate a delivery confidence score
Score ranges from 100 (likely to be stolen) to 1,000 (safe for delivery)
BigQuery serves as data repository; Vertex AI runs fraud detection and route anomaly models
Businesses using DeliveryDefense data could reduce post-delivery losses by up to 30%
zh: 分析 130 億筆 UPS 投遞記錄（涵蓋 1.3 億個地址），生成投遞信心評分
評分範圍從 100（可能遭竊）至 1,000（安全投遞）

使用 DeliveryDefense 資料的企業最多可將投遞後損失降低 30%

summary.en: 704 Apps uses Gemini to analyze in-trip audio and flag hostile keywords in real time, protecting last-mile drivers and passengers.
summary.zh: 704 Apps 利用 Gemini 即時分析行程中的音訊並標記敵意關鍵字，保護末端物流駕駛與乘客的安全。

overview.en: 704 Apps develops applications for the last-mile transportation segment in Latin America, connecting thousands of drivers and passengers daily. During trips, audio from conversations inside the vehicle is sent to Gemini, which measures the emotional 'temperature' of the exchange. Specific words associated with threats — such as 'robbery', 'assault', or 'kidnapping' — trigger hostile classification, generating real-time alerts so that safety teams can intervene before incidents escalate.
overview.zh: 704 Apps 為拉丁美洲的末端物流運輸領域開發應用程式，每天連結數千名駕駛與乘客。在行程中，車內對話的音訊會傳送至 Gemini，由其評估對話的情緒「溫度」。與威脅相關的特定詞彙——如「搶劫」、「攻擊」或「綁架」——將觸發敵意分類，產生即時警報，讓安全團隊能在事態升級前介入處理。

en: In-trip audio streamed to Gemini for real-time emotional temperature analysis
Threat keywords (e.g. robbery, assault, kidnapping) trigger hostile classification alerts
Proactive safety intervention before incidents escalate
Serves thousands of drivers and passengers daily across Latin America
zh: 行程中的音訊即時串流至 Gemini 進行情緒溫度分析

summary.en: BMW used Wiz on Google Cloud to cut critical security issues by 95% and gain full visibility across thousands of cloud workloads within days.

overview.en: BMW needed centralized visibility and transparency into its complex multi-cloud environment after finding that cloud-native security tools with different controls and rule sets provided no standardized global view. The company implemented Wiz (now part of Google Cloud) to address this, achieving a 95% reduction in critical issues even as the number of cloud workloads doubled. The solution democratized security work across multiple teams, giving them the visibility needed to understand vulnerabilities and take swift remediation steps.
overview.zh: BMW 在其複雜的多雲環境中，發現採用不同控制項與規則集的雲端原生安全工具無法提供標準化的全域視圖，因此需要集中化的可視性與透明度。該公司實施了 Wiz（現為 Google Cloud 的一部分）來解決這個問題，即使雲端工作負載數量翻倍，關鍵問題仍減少了 95%。此解決方案將安全工作普及至多個團隊，讓他們能夠了解漏洞並迅速採取補救措施。
